heading: Expressions — string operations
text:
### Expressions — string operations [LNLS.4.4]

Overlays [LEXP.3.X] (string built-ins) and [LSTR.3.2] (string
ordering).

An interpolated string — subject to LNLS.3.2 (output vocabulary must be
compile-time-known).

Substring and prefix/suffix tests are regex ([LREG.10.11]) and are bounded by
LNLS.3.7 rather than by this rule.

`len` — always O(1) for interned strings; allowed unconditionally.

`==`, `!=` — O(1) pointer equality on interned strings; always allowed.

String ordering via `<`, `>`, `<=`, `>=`:
- Allowed in single-pattern position on slots with `capacity` (LNLS.3.10).
- A compile error in cross-pattern position regardless of `capacity` (LNLS.3.8).

With `capacity` declared on all String slots, every string operation in
a `linear_scan: false` program evaluates in O(1) time (see [LNLS.5.7]).
